verdicts.reason: A and B are almost pixel-identical, and both are broken in the same ways. The colourful geometric background is gone, leaving only a stray striped sliver cut off at the bottom edge, so the brand feel is lost. The white frame has become an empty box floating on the right. The pink dots sit at the far left and right edges, away from the headline. 'DEAN COOPER' now sits above 'DDG STUDIO PRESENTS', which breaks the reading order. 'THE MINIMALIST' and the opening date are jammed onto one line at a tiny size. The text group is off-centre and leaves large dead white areas. B is only shifted a few pixels to the right, which is not a real difference.
